tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently started a job on campus. Your academic advisor, Professor Patel, has been helpful in guiding you through your studies. However, you are finding it difficult to balance your work schedule with your academic commitments. Write an email to Professor Patel.
bullets: Thank her for the support and guidance she has provided.
Discuss why you are having difficulty completing your academic commitments.
Explain how you plan to balance your academic commitments and work plans.
tasks.subject: Request to discuss academic and work balance
